coverage_limits: No R10 firmware, assembled board, physical timing, electrical/thermal/transient/endurance, actual20ms lot firing or flight tests exist; none executed or inferred here.
The safety lens is full for the current firing/switch/sense/reset/policy/back-feed/backup path. It does not replace other lenses, native whole-project DRC/ERC/build or procurement/process acceptance.

Static gate topology and nominal geometry do not prove hot leakage/Miller/reset waveforms, RF immunity, conformal-coat leakage, fabricated barrel allocation, DB125 retention or accessible rail/tool fit.

Source/harness resistances, fire-time pack reserve, converter allocation, FET resistance/copper temperature and capacitor behavior are conditional calculation inputs. Shorted-match logic survival remains a bench gate.

The independent Blue Jay is required to have its own battery/deployment circuit and zero shared copper. No board connector/interface to it exists; actual vehicle harness isolation cannot be proved from CAD.
Normal20ms and fault36ms are separate contracts. No automatic retry/repetitive pulse qualification follows from a single-pulse graph.

Named static ST cache was Rev8, so fresh maker Rev11 web contents supplied the actual Rev11 limits. A direct PDF download attempt timed out; no successful local Rev11 download is claimed. RM0433 web retrieval exceeded service size; trace override remains explicitly unverified.

An initial multi-board native mutation fixture crashed with SWIG lifetime errors after seven detections; five isolated footprint-removal fixtures also segfaulted. No crash is counted as a detection. Repaired native pad-disconnection controls completed with exit0; all15 final controls have explicit rejection evidence.
No peer current-round reports/probes read, no subagents, no GUI retry, no source/CAD/fab mutations, no Git command/mutation, no canonical build/check invocation.
